package.name: amr_hardware
package.description: Runs ON the robot's Raspberry Pi 5 (ROS 2 Jazzy). Mirrors the Webots-simulated AMR: subscribes to the same /cmd_vel the simulated robot's wheels are driven by (published over the network by the dev machine's Nav2 stack) and drives the real Dynamixel MX-106R wheels to match. Also brings up the real LiDAR, IMU and ultrasonic sensors and a hardware e-stop, independent of the mirroring.
